title: "Lake County COAD Community Resilience Centers"

  html:

    theme: flatly

---

This map shows community resilience centers in Lake County that are part of the
[Community Organizations Active in Disaster (COAD)](https://www.lakecountycoad.org)
network. These sites provide shelter, cooling, and resources during extreme heat
events and other emergencies.

For county emergency preparedness resources, visit the
[Lake County Office of Climate Resiliency](https://www.lakecountyca.gov/1436/Office-of-Climate-Resiliency).

---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(leaflet)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(htmltools)

sites <- read_csv("sites.csv")

# Pre-compute per-row values to avoid named-vector lookup issues in Leaflet
sites <- sites %>%
  mutate(
    hex_color    = case_when(status == "Active" ~ "#27ae60", TRUE ~ "#e67e22"),
    marker_color = case_when(status == "Active" ~ "green",   TRUE ~ "orange"),
    status_label = case_when(
      status == "Active" ~ "Active — open during events",
      TRUE               ~ "Setup — not yet accepting residents"
    )
  )

# Build popup HTML for each site
make_popup <- function(name, hex_color, status_label, address,
                       phone, website, facebook, hours, services, notes) {
  out <- paste0("<b style='font-size:14px;'>", name, "</b><br>")
  out <- paste0(out,
    "<span style='color:", hex_color, ";font-weight:bold;'>",
    status_label, "</span><br><br>"
  )
  out <- paste0(out, address, "<br>")
  if (!is.na(phone)    && nchar(phone)    > 0)
    out <- paste0(out, "&#128222; <a href='tel:", phone, "'>", phone, "</a><br>")
  if (!is.na(website)  && nchar(website)  > 0)
    out <- paste0(out, "&#127760; <a href='", website, "' target='_blank'>Website</a><br>")
  if (!is.na(facebook) && nchar(facebook) > 0)
    out <- paste0(out, "&#128100; <a href='", facebook, "' target='_blank'>Facebook</a><br>")
  if (!is.na(hours)    && nchar(hours)    > 0)
    out <- paste0(out, "<br><b>Hours:</b> ", hours, "<br>")
  if (!is.na(services) && nchar(services) > 0)
    out <- paste0(out, "<b>Services:</b> ", services, "<br>")
  if (!is.na(notes)    && nchar(notes)    > 0)
    out <- paste0(out, "<br><i>", notes, "</i>")
  out
}

sites <- sites %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(popup = make_popup(name, hex_color, status_label, address,
                            phone, website, facebook, hours, services, notes)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Build per-row pin icons (awesomeMarkers = classic teardrop/locator shape)
icons <- awesomeIcons(
  icon        = "home",
  iconColor   = "white",
  library     = "fa",
  markerColor = sites$marker_color
)

leaflet(sites) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%
  setView(lng = -122.85, lat = 38.98, zoom = 10) %>%
  addAwesomeMarkers(
    lng   = ~lng,
    lat   = ~lat,
    icon  = icons,
    popup = ~popup,
    label = ~name,
    labelOptions = labelOptions(
      style     = list("font-weight" = "bold", "font-size" = "13px"),
      direction = "top",
      offset    = c(0, -40)
    )
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    colors   = c("#27ae60", "#e67e22"),
    labels   = c("Active — open during events",
                 "Setup — not yet accepting residents"),
    title    = "Site Status",
    opacity  = 0.9
  )
```
